meta.title: Create Upload URL
meta.summary: Prepare direct media uploads from file metadata. Returns a pre-signed upload URL and file reference for avatar cloning, generation, and media-processing workflows.

hero.title: Create Upload URL
hero.summary: Prepare direct media uploads from file metadata. Returns a pre-signed upload URL and file reference for avatar cloning, generation, and media-processing workflows.

endpoint_summary.summary: Create a direct upload URL and target object for a file.

auth_requirements.title: Auth Requirements
items: Authentication is required via Authorization header.

preconditions.title: Preconditions
items: Try it is available after login because the returned upload target is account-scoped.
Use this as the first step in most Playground and agent flows.

fields.name: extension
fields.description: File extension without dot, for example mp4.

fields.name: media_type
fields.description:
Media type used to validate extension and build the object path.\
\
. utilityhpb.MediaType:\
... enums:\
..... MEDIA_TYPE_UNDEFINED\
..... VIDEO: Video file, such as mp4.\
..... AUDIO: Audio file, such as mp3.\
..... IMAGE: Image file, such as png.\
..... DOCUMENT: Document file, such as md or docx.

fields.name: code
fields.description:
response code enums:\
.. 0: ok\
.. 12: invalid input\
.. 13: unauthenticated\
.. 16: rate limit\
.. 99: server error

fields.name: data.content_type
fields.description: Expected content type for the upload request.

fields.name: data.file
fields.description: File reference that should be reused in later media APIs.

fields.name: data.upload_url
fields.description: Pre-signed upload URL that the client uploads to directly.

related_links.title: File reference
related_links.description: Persist the uploaded file as a file reference.
